question: In the upper reaches of the atmosphere, a molecule containing three atoms of oxygen is found. This forms a layer called:
solution:
The correct answer is the __**ozone layer.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ozone **is natural gas.
 
• It is an** allotrope **of oxygen consisting of** three atoms of oxygen** bound together in a non-linear fashion.
 
• The chemical symbol of** ozone is O₃.**
 
• It is present in the **stratosphere.**
 
• It lies in the range of **15km-30km.**
 
• It protects us from** harmful ultraviolet radiation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
